rows.label: tlk41100123_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I heard the water tower over at
Kloom Farm got totally wrecked!

rows.label: tlk41100123_02_msg0002
rows.name:
And even worse, they let
that bad guy from Iira
they'd captured get away!

rows.label: tlk41100123_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Pretty pathetic, even with the
Radiant Noble of Flame there.

rows.label: tlk41100123_02_msg0005
rows.name:
My mom was worried. She told me to be
careful because the scary person who
wrecked the water tower is in town.

rows.label: tlk41100123_02_msg0006
rows.name:
You don't look like you're from around
here either, but you seem like good
people, so I guess you're fine.
